reward_docs.action_over_limit_penalty: Penalise commanding a joint target beyond its hard limit (+ overshoot).
reward_docs.action_rate_l2: Penalize the rate of change of the actions using L2 squared kernel.
reward_docs.action_rate_l2_fallen_scaled: mjlab action_rate_l2, multiplied by ``fallen_scale`` while tilt > gate.
reward_docs.angular_momentum_penalty: Penalize whole-body angular momentum to encourage natural arm swing.
reward_docs.apply_mouth_payload_force: Hook par-step (utilisé comme reward de poids 0) : applique le POIDS de l'objet tenu dans la bouche comme force externe verticale au mouth_tip, gaté sur la remontée (phase >= hold_end, rampe rapide au moment du 'grab').
reward_docs.ball_forward_velocity: Ball XY velocity along the per-env kick direction, clamped to [0, max].
reward_docs.ball_speed_overshoot_penalty: Ball forward speed in excess of ``target_speed`` (linear, ≥ 0).
reward_docs.body_ang_vel_at_height: Trunk ``sum(ω_xy²)`` penalty gated by trunk z (and optionally tilt).
reward_docs.body_impact_cost: Penalize terrain contact forces above a threshold on protected body parts.
reward_docs.body_pose_tracking_6d: Mean of 6 per-axis Gaussian rewards for tracking commanded body pose.
reward_docs.body_upright_gaussian: Gaussian reward on tilt magnitude — sharp pull toward fully vertical.
reward_docs.body_upright_linear: Linear reward for body uprightness — provides gradient at every tilt angle.
reward_docs.braking_reward: Reward coming to a stop when cmd_x < 0 (brake commanded).
reward_docs.com_height_target: Reward for keeping the center of mass within a target height range. Returns positive reward when in range, negative penalty when outside.
reward_docs.com_upward_velocity: Reward upward CoM velocity to incentivize dynamic standup motion.
reward_docs.crouch_forward_lean: Léger penché AVANT du tronc pendant l'accroupi (gaté par le blend crouch).
reward_docs.crouch_glide_pose_by_phase: Gaussian match to a phase-interpolated joint pose (stand <-> crouch).
reward_docs.crouch_glide_pose_l1: L1 bootstrap toward the phase-interpolated crouch pose (negative penalty).
reward_docs.fallen_state_penalty: 1.0 while FALLEN (weight it negative): a flat per-step tax on staying down. Without it, lying still is ~0/step while attempting recovery costs action-rate/torque penalties — waiting for the fallen_too_long recycle was the rational policy. (
reward_docs.feet_air_time_upright: velocity template feet_air_time, zeroed while FALLEN (tilt > gate).
reward_docs.feet_clearance: Penalize deviation from target clearance height, weighted by foot velocity.
reward_docs.feet_flat_penalty: Penalize foot sites not being parallel to the ground.
reward_docs.feet_grounded_reward: Positive reward for feet contacting the ground (0, +0.5, or +1.0).
reward_docs.feet_slip: Penalize foot sliding (xy velocity while in contact).
reward_docs.feet_swing_height: Penalize deviation from target swing height, evaluated at landing.
reward_docs.forward_lean_reward: Reward leaning slightly forward when pushing, to counteract the backward torque from skating strokes.
reward_docs.forward_speed_reward: Récompense la vitesse avant du tronc (conserver l'élan / ne pas freiner).
reward_docs.gait_symmetry_penalty: Penalize lopsided left/right foot usage (one blade doing most of the work).
reward_docs.glide_reward: Reward the GLIDE phase of a stride: coast on ONE blade with quiet legs.
reward_docs.ground_pick_return_pose_phased: ground_pick_return_pose gaté par la up-gate segmentée (remontée+repos).
reward_docs.ground_pick_return_upright_phased: ground_pick_return_upright gaté par la up-gate segmentée.
reward_docs.grounded_reward: Reward BOTH blades in contact — a classic swizzle stays grounded (no lifting).
reward_docs.head_pose_bias_penalty: Penalize the time-averaged (DC) neck/head tracking error: -mean(|EMA(err)|).
reward_docs.head_pose_tracking: Per-joint Gaussian reward for matching commanded neck/head deltas.
reward_docs.heading_hold_reward: Reward holding the SPAWN heading (go straight) — corrective, angle-based.
reward_docs.heading_tracking_reward: Reward for reducing heading error when cmd[2] encodes heading error.
reward_docs.height_progress: Potential-based height shaping: Δ min(trunk z, ceiling) per step.
reward_docs.height_target_gaussian: Gaussian on trunk z against a single fixed target.
reward_docs.joint_deviation_l1: L1 penalty for joint positions deviating from their default (HOME).
reward_docs.joint_pos_limits: Penalize joint positions if they cross the soft limits.
reward_docs.joint_torque_rate_l2: Penalize rate of change in actuator torques (proxy for gearbox shock).
reward_docs.joint_torques_l2: Penalize actuator forces (torques) to encourage energy-efficient motion.
reward_docs.leg_antisymmetry: Amorce le CISEAU des jambes (une avant / une arrière) pendant le spin.
reward_docs.leg_symmetry_reward: Reward left/right legs mirroring — the swizzle's defining symmetry.
reward_docs.mouth_ground_proximity_phased: mouth_ground_proximity gaté par la down-gate segmentée (descente+palier).
reward_docs.mouth_perpendicular_phased: mouth_perpendicular_to_ground gaté par la down-gate segmentée.
reward_docs.neck_action_rate_l2: Penalize the rate of change of neck actions (action_t - action_{t-1}). Neck joints are indices 5-8 (4 joints total).
reward_docs.neck_joint_pos_l2: Penalize neck/head joint position deviation from default (L2 squared).
reward_docs.neck_torque_when_tilted: Cost (≥ 0 → NEGATIVE weight): mean (|τ_neck| / torque_scale)² × gate.
reward_docs.neck_vel_descent_penalty: Pénalise la vitesse des joints du cou pendant la DESCENTE+palier (freine le piqué de la tête).
reward_docs.pose_l1_penalty: L1 companion to ``pose_target_match`` (constant gradient toward target).
reward_docs.pose_target_match: Gaussian pose-match against a single fixed target.
reward_docs.posture_composite: Multiplicative goal score vs the commanded posture (height·upright·pose [·head]).
reward_docs.posture_height_gaussian: Gaussian on trunk z against the commanded posture's target height.
reward_docs.posture_height_l1: L1 companion to ``posture_height_gaussian`` — the transition driver.
reward_docs.posture_pose_l1: L1 companion to ``posture_pose_match`` (constant gradient to target).
reward_docs.posture_pose_match: Gaussian pose-match against the commanded posture's target pose.
reward_docs.posture_rise_bootstrap: Upward-vz reward, active only when STAND is commanded and z < max_height.
reward_docs.posture_stillness: Reward trunk stillness while AT the commanded posture, upright.
reward_docs.recovery_success: One-shot bounty on a COMPLETED recovery: fires on the frame where an env that has been fallen (tilt > fallen_tilt for ≥ min_fallen_s) becomes genuinely upright (tilt < up_tilt AND trunk z > up_z). Hysteresis: re-arms only by being fallen ag
reward_docs.roulade_flatness_penalty: (lateral-axis world-z)² — dense gradient toward a sagittal roll.
reward_docs.roulade_head_pivot: Reward head-ground contact while rotating forward mid-roll.
reward_docs.roulade_height_after_roll: Broad height Gaussian × completion gate — pull up to standing height.
reward_docs.roulade_landing_sharp: Tight-std upright × height Gaussians × completion gate — the last mile.
reward_docs.roulade_lateral_velocity_penalty: Body-frame lateral (y) linear velocity² — keeps the roll straight.
reward_docs.roulade_overspeed_penalty: max(0, |ω_y| − omega_max)² — quadratic tax on whip-speed rotation.
reward_docs.roulade_progress: Pay increments of the progress frontier, up to one full roll.
reward_docs.roulade_rise_velocity: com_upward_velocity × late-roll gate — bootstrap the exit rise.
reward_docs.roulade_sagittal_penalty: Rotation out of the sagittal plane: body-frame ω_x² + ω_z² (positive; use a negative weight). ω_y is the roll axis and stays free.
reward_docs.roulade_stand_tax: SELF-NEGATING height L1 below target, active only after roll completion.
reward_docs.roulade_upright_after_roll: Linear cos(tilt) × completion gate — bootstrap pull toward vertical.
reward_docs.servo_acc_spike_penalty: Sum over servos of ReLU(|joint accel| - acc_thresh), accel by finite difference of joint velocity at the control rate.
reward_docs.servo_stall_penalty: Number of servos pushing hard against something that does not move.
reward_docs.single_foot_grounded_reward: Binary reward: 1 while the sensed foot touches the terrain.
reward_docs.single_support_reward: Reward single-support (a skating stride), mildly discourage the swizzle.
reward_docs.skating_air_time_reward: Reward feet air time only when pushing (cmd_x > 0).
reward_docs.soft_landing: Penalize high impact forces at landing to encourage soft footfalls.
reward_docs.spin_grounded: Les deux lames au sol pendant le spin — empêche « je saute et je vrille ».
reward_docs.spin_rate_l1: Bootstrap L1 : gradient constant vers la cible même quand la gaussienne de `spin_rate_track` sature loin de la cible. À utiliser avec un poids POSITIF (la valeur retournée est déjà négative).
reward_docs.spin_rate_track: Objectif principal du spin : suivre la vitesse de lacet cible ω*(φ).
reward_docs.spin_stay_in_place: Coût ‖v_xy‖² du tronc : tourner SUR PLACE, et tuer l'élan d'entrée.
reward_docs.spin_wheel_differential: Récompense la rotation EN ROULEMENT (et non en patinage).
reward_docs.standing_composite_score: Smooth multiplicative goal-state score (product of three Gaussians).
reward_docs.track_angular_velocity: Reward heading error for heading-controlled envs, angular velocity for others.
reward_docs.track_linear_velocity: Reward for tracking the commanded base linear velocity.
reward_docs.track_yaw_rate_fine: Yaw-rate-only Gaussian, exp(-(wz_cmd - wz)²/std²), ADDED next to the stock track_angular_velocity (which stays as is).
reward_docs.trunk_downward_velocity_penalty: Penalty on downward trunk velocity beyond ``max_down_vel``.
reward_docs.trunk_upward_velocity_penalty: Penalty on upward trunk velocity beyond ``max_up_vel``.
reward_docs.trunk_vertical_accel_penalty: Penalty proportional to ``|a_z|`` of the trunk (finite-diff of v_z).
reward_docs.upright: Reward for keeping the base upright.
reward_docs.upright_body_cmd_relative: mjlab's flat-ground ``upright`` (exp(-|g_b,xy|²/std²)), measured against the COMMANDED roll/pitch instead of level: target g_b = (sin θ, -sin φ·cos θ) for body command roll φ = cmd[3], pitch θ = cmd[4] (ZYX, same convention as body_pose_tra
reward_docs.upright_gaussian_at_height: ``body_upright_gaussian`` weighted by smoothstep on trunk z.
reward_docs.upright_progress: Potential-based upright shaping: Δcos(tilt) per step.
reward_docs.upright_while_tall: Linear upright reward weighted by a smoothstep on trunk z.
reward_docs.variable_posture: Penalize deviation from default pose with speed-dependent tolerance.
reward_docs.variable_posture_body_relaxed: mjlab ``variable_posture`` + a 4th regime: standing envs with an ACTIVE body command (any of ``body_active_axes`` non-zero) use ``std_body``.
reward_docs.wheel_glide_reward: Récompense le ROULEMENT des roues vers l'avant (glisse), plafonné.
reward_docs.wheel_speed_reward: Reward wheel spin proportional to commanded push.
